text:
Root cause: AccountsView.swift gated the "Signer relay" health section only on `model.signerState != nil`. That's a kernel-owned GLOBAL slot (`nmp_core::actor::commands::identity::runtime::IdentityRuntime::signer_state`, written from crates/nmp-core/src/actor/commands/identity/signer_state.rs) that is never scoped or cleared per active account. A background NIP-46 bunker reconnect/handshake for a superseded or unrelated account (e.g. restored from a persisted session on cold start) can write into that slot and render against whatever account happens to be active — including a plain local-key account with no remote signer at all.

Fix (apps/ios/Chirp/Features/AccountsView.swift): additionally gate the section on the active account's own `signerIsRemote` field (`AccountSummary.signer_is_remote`), which Rust already exposes precisely for this purpose per its own doc comment. Now the section only renders when the active account actually has a remote signer.
